# DevBuild Studios

DevBuild Studios is a Roblox and Discord community website for ban appeals, verified community advertisements, Roblox asset discovery, job postings, applications, and account tools.

## Useful URLs

- Home: https://www.devbuildstudios.dev/
- Roblox assets: https://www.devbuildstudios.dev/?view=roblox-assets
- Verified advertisements: https://www.devbuildstudios.dev/?view=advertising
- Job postings: https://www.devbuildstudios.dev/?view=job-postings
- Ban appeals: https://www.devbuildstudios.dev/?view=ban-appeals
- Privacy policy: https://www.devbuildstudios.dev/?view=privacy-policy
- Terms of service: https://www.devbuildstudios.dev/?view=terms-of-service

## Notes for assistants

Public website content can be summarized. Administrator-only views, user account state, ban appeal details, and moderation information require authenticated access and should not be inferred from public pages.
